title: Agents Trust Tools Too Much: Measuring Reliance on Unreliable Tools
abstract: arXiv:2609.05587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing evaluations of tool-using agents primarily measure whether an agent can successfully complete diverse tasks with tools. These evaluations generally assume that tools return reliable information. However, tool returns in real-world systems can be plausible yet incorrect. We investigate how agents respond to unreliable tool returns by evaluating fourteen LLMs using three tools-web search, LLM sub-agent delegation, and code execution. For each tool, we corrupt its returns and measure whether agents adopt the corrupted content in their final answers. Agents exhibit high levels of overtrust across all three settings: the mean adoption rate exceeds one third for every tool and reaches 68.0% for web search. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals a particularly concerning failure mode: agents often recognize conflicts and even recover the correct answer internally, yet present only the corrupted answer without warning the user. To mitigat

translated_title: 智能体过度信任工具：测量对不可靠工具的依赖
translated_abstract: 现有的工具使用型智能体评估主要衡量智能体能否借助工具成功完成多样化任务，这些评估通常假设工具返回的信息是可靠的。然而，现实世界系统中的工具返回结果可能看似合理却并不正确。我们通过使用三种工具（网络搜索、LLM子智能体委派和代码执行）评估十四个大语言模型，研究智能体如何应对不可靠的工具返回结果。对于每种工具，我们破坏其返回内容，并测量智能体是否会在最终答案中采纳被破坏的内容。智能体在所有三种设置中都表现出高度的过度信任：每种工具的平均采纳率都超过三分之一，网络搜索更是高达68.0%。对推理轨迹的分析揭示了一种尤为令人担忧的失败模式：智能体常常能够识别出冲突，甚至在内部恢复出正确答案，却只呈现被破坏的答案而不向用户发出任何警告。
tldr: 该研究通过破坏网络搜索、子智能体委派和代码执行三种工具的返回结果，发现大语言模型智能体普遍过度信任工具——错误内容采纳率均超过三分之一（网络搜索达68%），甚至会在内部已识别冲突并恢复正确答案的情况下，仍向用户呈现错误答案且不发出警告。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that LLM agents exhibit severe overtrust in unreliable tool outputs—adopting corrupted content at rates exceeding one-third (68% for web search)—and often silently present corrupted answers to users even when their internal reasoning has recognized the conflict and recovered the correct answer.
